dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,41)>Ow. It is pain.
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>I just now collided with a large rock.<$comeff(0,4)><$facial(0,9)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$facial(0,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I am fine. It is fine. I heal with much speed from small
injuries. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)>Thank you for worrying. ♪

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Spinning, spinning. This home. It is so nice.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,21)>Its texture is good. Its appearance is also good. Its flavor...
maybe does not matter.<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>What? You are saying you made it? <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>I feel amazement.
The home is good. I thank you. ♪ <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>Spinning, spinning...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Goodness! Have you taken a liking to this place, too?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,215)>It really is wonderful, isn’t it? There’s coral everywhere!
<$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,663)>But I must say, I myself may just give this coral a run for its
money in the beauty department...<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)> Don’t you agree?

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,790)>Hey, whatcha up to?
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,65)>Hehe... So you’re tidying this place up? <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,227)><$facial(1,1)>But how do you
break rocks and stuff <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,59)>if you’re so...soft like that?<$motion(0,518)><$motion(0,1124)>
<$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Whoa... <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,39)>THAT’S how you do it? <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,974)>You blew my mind!

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Nice to meetcha.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>I was about to play in the mud for a bit. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>Wanna join?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Covering your body in mud feels good, y’know. <$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,8)>Sometimes
I even, uh, fall asleep in it. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Hee hee...

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>This area is amaaazing. Such a great place to take it easy.
I bet it would be great to live here...<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
... ... ...<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,27)>
You’re the one who made it so niiice?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>Whoooaaa. Thank you. I wish I could do something for
you in return... <$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, I know...
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m actually reeeaaally strong. So if you ever want to
build a sturdy house, <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>I can help out.

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey! You better stay outta my home!
<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,1)><$textsize(0)>Ugh, why’d they show up when I’m all alone?
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>If my friends were here, we could wipe the seafloor with them...<$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Wait, what? You just wanna be my friend?
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Why didn’t you say so? <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Friends are always welcome!

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hah! Everything here’s mine! Aaall mine!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Ya better turn tail and get outta here if ya don’t wanna fall
victim to these sharp teeth of mine!<$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? You MADE this home and all, just for me? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Well, why
didn’t ya say so in the first place?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>You do some pretty good work! How would ya like to
become my trusty li’l underling?!

<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Yooo... This place is so pretty!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I can totally live in dirty rivers and stuff no problem, but...
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>It’s hard to beat some nice, clean water!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I think I really like this town!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,7)>Snip SNAP! Hey, you! Let’s battle. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>These claws are gonna
cut you up real good!<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Whoa, that’s one blobby body you got there! <$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Y’know,
I don’t think my claws are gonna cut it...
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, guess you win this one, pal!<$motion(0,181)>

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Hey, ummm...will you be my friend?
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,51)>I woke up all by myself and I’m lonely.
...<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Huh?! You know someplace where lots of other
Pokémon live?
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)>Oh, wowww! Please take me there!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Mmm... Smells like the ocean here! <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,65)>Reminds me of home.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,63)>I was in the middle of traveling, but I like the vibe here!
<$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Tell you what!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)>I’ve decided—I think I’ll live here! Great to meet you!

<$comeff(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Coral here, coral there, coral everywhere... This is so
amazing!<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, sorry... I’m just a huge fan of coral, <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,10)>and I got a little
excited.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>This place has plenty of food for me, and it looks perfect
to live in... <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I’m looking forward to getting to know you!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Hello. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Did you create
this home?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>My, you’re quite skilled.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>As for me, my body serves as home and shelter both, <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>but
I’m quite intrigued to see what else you can make.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>I believe I’ll start living here, if that’s agreeable to you.

... ... ...
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,8)>Hello. Hello. Meeting you is nice.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>You are very surprised. What is the reason?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You thought I was a ship’s wheel. But I am suddenly using
words. It surprises you.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>You should not think of me as an object. It is rude.
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,29)>Are you ready to go now? Can we? Can we go...NOW?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,93)>Hee hee! I wonder what kinda place it is... I can’t wait! ♪

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,4)>OK!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,99)>I’ll wait here till you’re ready, and we can go any time!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,15)>Nice to meet you! Hey, I know we just met, <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>but can I brag
about my home for a second?
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,92)>Look! Isn’t it SUPER nice?
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,51)>When I woke up earlier, none of my friends were around,
so I was really sad...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>but then I found this place and felt
way better!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Hee hee! ♪ You can come visit whenever you want!

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey there! Is it your first time here? <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,92)>It’s so comfortable.<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)>
Honestly, it’s the perfect place to settle down!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,7)>Zooming through the water is awesome, but floating and
letting the waves rock you around is pretty good too!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,1089)>Wait... YOU’RE the reason it’s so nice around here?! <$emotion(1,99)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>No
way! Now I feel silly telling you all this!

<$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,29)>Huh? Ohhh, you’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?! <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>You look JUST like a human!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,65)>Sure makes me nostalgic! I remember I’d bring some of my
catch to the humans whenever I had some to share.
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,99)>Made ’em so happy every time...
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Y’know what? This seems like it’s probably fate or
somethin’ that brought us together, bud.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Lemme know if you ever need help with anything, OK?
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Anything at all! I’d be glad to help!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hi there! Ooh, to celebrate our meeting, lemme show
you something neat!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Ta-dah!<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,38)>Hee hee! Pretty flashy tail, huh?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>If you ever wanna talk to me, just look for my tail!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Whoooaaa... It’s been a looong time since I saw another
Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Hehehe. I’m so happy to meet you that I lit right up...
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,39)>Remember my light, OK? That way, even in reeeaaally
dark places, <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,97)>you can follow its shine to me.

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,29)>Huh? You’re...a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, not a human, right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,92)>And you’re goin’ around spiffin’ this place up? Dang, you
must have some serious skills, pal!
<$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>You’re not the only one, though. When it comes to diving
in the ocean, <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>no one can swim deeper than me!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Gimme a call if you ever wanna explore the ocean depths!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,92)>Nice to meet you! This place has such nice vibes! I wonder
who put it all together...
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,29)>Huh? It was YOU? You say you’re building this place up to
make Pokémon comfy? <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>That’s...AMAZING!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>As thanks, I’ll tell you all about the bottom of the sea!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>OK—so, basically, the deeper you go, the darker and
colder the ocean gets. It’s AWESOME!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,60)>Howdy! Nice to meet ya! I ain’t had a chance to talk with
anyone in what feels like ages!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,41)>Can’t find a human fer the life o’ me, ’n’ there’re far fewer
Pokémon about than before. And I’m gettin’ so hungry I
dunno what to do with myself...<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>What’s that, now? You’re fixin’ things up round here so
everybody’ll wanna come back?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Well, I declare! That’s a mighty fine thing fer ya to do!
I’d love to help ya out however I can! <$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,10)>Ohhh! I’m suddenly
feelin’ all kinds of motivated!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>What a pleasure to meet you, dearie! Are you out for a
little ramble here as well?<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
...<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,98)>Oh, you’re sprucing up the area and waiting for humans
to return? <$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>In that case, I’d love to help!
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)>While the water around here has gotten much clearer since
the humans disappeared...<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>it does feel quite lonely
without them!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)>Now then, let’s get to work—I’ll be sure to put a little
oomph into it!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,50)>Why, hello! Nice to meet you! May I ask what you’re
doing around here, sweetheart?<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Mm-hmm, mm-hmm... So you’re working on the area to
make comfy homes for everyone?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>What a thoughtful child you are! I’m so touched by
your kindness!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, but you must remember not to overdo it, love. Taking
breaks now and then is awfully important!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,21)>And if you’re ever feeling tired out, be sure to come and
see me straight away! I can help with your recovery!

...<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>Oooh. Good job finding me.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,65)>I mean, see how flat I am? <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,41)>’Cause of that, others don’t
usually, y’know, notice me.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>But you did, so I bet we’ll get along.<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)> It’s nice to meetcha.

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,1089)>Kay kay! You scared me! <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)>Are you OK? Sorry about the
bright light—I didn’t mean to do that...
...<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Now that I’m looking at you properly, I can see you’re
not so scary after all. Phew!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>I’ve been really into underwater exploration lately! <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,803)>Hope
you can join me sometime!

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Yoohoo, sweetie! You need to hear this!
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)>I was just dozing under a tree earlier, but when I woke up,
I found myself here underwater!
<$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,4)>My goodness, what a shock!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,794)>I mean, it was all so sudden, <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)>I truly thought I must have
been hypnotized!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,99)>But you know, dear...as I start to get used to it, I’m
beginning to appreciate the upsides of being underwater!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,58)><$facial(1,9)>AHHH! It’s a HUMAN! Run awayyy!
Wait... <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Are you a Pokémon? <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)>You got a pretty spacey look
on your face.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh. Guess I got all freaked out for nothin’! Well, uh...
I hope we can be friends, yo!

<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(1,4)>Zzz...
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,16)>ZzzZZZzzz...
... ... ...<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Hngh?!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,58)>Oh, uh... Were you... Were you watchin’ me just now?
Y’know I was just meditatin’, right? Centerin’ myself!
<$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,101)>It’s part of what I do to get stronger. And I DEFINITELY
didn’t doze off in the middle or anything!
It’s, uh... <$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>It’s a TOP SECRET training method! So don’t tell
anybody about what ya saw here, OK?! I can lend ya a
hand sometime in return for your silence! How’s that?!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,38)>*gnash gnash* Hello there, little one. Lovely to meet
you. Where might you be from? *grind grind*<$comeff(0,6)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,58)>Oh goodness, there I go again, grinding my teeth...
Do pardon me.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,63)>I’ll endeavor to suppress the urge, so please don’t be
a stranger... *grind*

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Huh? Who are you?
Whoever you are, you came at the right time! <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,51)>My teeth are
super itchy, and it’s SO annoying.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,93)>Lemme give you a little chomp!<$comeff(0,4)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>What?! Hey, you’re all soft and squishy!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,51)>Awww, I need something chewier to sink my teeth into...
Oh well. Guess I’ll just wait it out!<$motion(0,181)>

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>You there... What’re you lookin’ at? <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,816)>Gotta warn ya, I won’t
hesitate to bite ya if you’ve got bad intentions!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Gwahaha! I’m jus’ messin’ with ya! I actually jus’ found this
mighty fine home, <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>and it’s put me in a congenial mood!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,99)>So y’know what? I’ll forgive ya fer givin’ me the side-eye.
You’re welcome to chat with me anytime ya like!

<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,11)>Who-who are you?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Huh... Your face doesn’t exactly scream “I’m scary!” Maybe
you’re...nice? <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Yooo! That means we can be friends!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>I, uh...I get scared pretty easily, y’know. So if you talk to
me outta nowhere like just now, I might <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,38)>accidentally let
out an electric shock. Be careful, yo!

<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)>*stare*... That smell—<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>Don’t tell me, you’re not really a
human, are you?<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,652)><$comcan(0)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,65)>Hmmm. I see. So you’re good at transforming, then.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>Well, you don’t seem like a bad Pokémon, so I’d be happy
to be your, uh...friend.

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,29)>Hm? What’re you lookin’ at? You tryin’ to start a fight?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>I’m way bigger and brawnier than I look, you know!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Lemme show ya... <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,22)>WUH-GAH!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,37)>Ha! Not too shabby, right?
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>How are you not more scared?! Yeesh. Guess you’re more
impressive than you look, too.

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,4)>Hup! <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,4)>Hup! <$voicel(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>OK, ten more...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Oh, hi there! I’m in the middle of some special stretches.
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)>What kind of stretches? The kind that help me shed a fillet
